SketchesPage.heading: Before the build, the drawing
SketchesPage.intro: Sketches are a fundamental part of our creative process, allowing us to provide an initial vision that closely represents the final outcome of the project. Through freehand drawing, we can interact with the client in a fast, direct, and dynamic way from the very early stages of the design process. These sketches help clients gradually visualize what the finished project will look like while actively participating in its development. In addition, during on-site meetings, changes and adjustments can be made instantly, without the need to return to the studio or wait for 3D images to be produced. Although today’s digital tools make it possible to generate 3D renderings quickly, freehand sketching remains the fastest, most flexible, and most effective way to communicate ideas, explore solutions, and make decisions efficiently.
